description: A Delphi-developed and psychometrically tested questionnaire for measuring tertiary-hospital ICU nurses' knowledge, attitudes, and practices concerning postextubation swallowing disorders.
title: 30-item ICU nurses' postextubation swallowing-disorders knowledge, attitude, and practice questionnaire

description: A validated and pilot-tested multiple-choice listening assessment developed by Taguchi to measure EFL learners’ comprehension of implied opinions in spoken English conversations.
title: 30-item multiple choice pragmatic listening comprehension test (Taguchi 2007, 2008)

description: A researcher-developed 30-item posttest measuring university students’ academic content-area reading comprehension through word-attack and text-attack skills, expert validated and tried out before administration.
title: 30-item posttest of micro reading skills (word attack and text attack skills)

description: A KR-20-validated, researcher-developed 30-item achievement test measuring fifth-grade students' knowledge of the Production, Distribution and Consumption unit in social studies.
title: 30-item researcher-developed academic achievement test for the Production, Distribution and Consumption unit

description: A 30-item single-choice, image-based diagnostic test developed by Xie Wenjia et al.
title: 30-question image-based diagnostic test for infectious keratitis
